> - Book Colosseum timed-entry tickets well in advance — popular slots sell out quickly.
> - Buy Leonardo Express tickets ahead of travel to guarantee seats and schedules.
> - St Peter's Basilica has security queues and a strict dress code; dome access costs extra.
> - Pantheon interior access can be closed for services or have a small fee.
> - Reserve dinners in Trastevere and Monti on weekends — places fill up early.

# 3-day itinerary — Rome

## Day 1 — Arrival; Colosseum evening visit
- **15:30** — [Leonardo Express (FCO–Termini)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Termini+station+Rome)
  - Official train one-way €14 (2026). Trains ~32–35 min. Alternative: taxi flat €55 to historic centre.
  - 35 min · €14 per person

- **16:10** — [Walk to Hotel 55 Fifty-Five](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Termini+station+Rome&destination=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome)
  - High-walking pace; ~10–15 min on foot from Termini.
  - 15 min · €0 per person

- **16:30** — [Hotel check-in & luggage drop](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome)
  - Lodging costed once for the stay (estimate per person for 2 nights at a mid-range hotel).
  - 30 min · €160 per person

- **17:00** — [Walk to Colosseum](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome&destination=Colosseum+Rome)
  - Walk ~20–25 min at a brisk pace. Alternative: taxi ~10–15 min (€10–15).
  - 25 min · €0 per person

- **17:30** — [Colosseum](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Colosseum+Rome)
  - Timed-entry ticket Colosseum + Roman Forum + Palatine ~€18. Open until ~19:15 in early Sep; book a timed slot in advance.
  - 90 min · €18 per person

- **19:30** — [Dinner](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Monti+neighbourhood+Rome)
  - Mid-range dinner ~€80 per person.
  - 90 min · €80 per person


_Day total: €272_

## Day 2 — Historic centre, shopping at noon, Villa Borghese and Trastevere in evening
- **09:00** — [Trevi Fountain](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Trevi+Fountain+Rome)
  - Outdoor visit to the fountain and square — free.
  - 30 min · €0 per person

- **09:45** — [Pantheon](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Pantheon+Rome)
  - Visiting the square is free; interior may have a small entry fee (~€5). Priced as an approximate interior fee — check current policy.
  - 45 min · €5 per person

- **12:00** — Shopping stop
  - Shopping at noon as requested — browsing is free; purchases extra.
  - 90 min · €0 per person

- **13:30** — [Lunch](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Via+del+Corso+%2F+Centro+Rome)
  - Mid-range lunch ~€40 per person.
  - 60 min · €40 per person

- **15:00** — [Villa Borghese gardens (park walk)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Villa+Borghese+Rome)
  - Large park and gardens — nature-style time; free. Optional bike/boat rental extra.
  - 90 min · €0 per person

- **17:30** — [Public transport to Trastevere](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Trastevere+Rome)
  - Priced as a single public-transport ticket €1.50 per person. Alternative: scenic walk across the Tiber (~30–45 min) or taxi (~€10–15).
  - 25 min · €2 per person

- **19:30** — [Dinner](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Trastevere+Rome)
  - Mid-range dinner ~€80 per person; lively area for evening strolls.
  - 90 min · €80 per person


_Day total: €127_

## Day 3 — Vatican / St Peter's, riverside walk, return to airport
- **08:25** — [Walk to St Peter's Basilica](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome&destination=St+Peter%27s+Basilica+Rome)
  - Walk ~25–35 min to arrive by 09:00; leaves earlier than 09:00 so you can reach the basilica for opening. Alternative: bus/taxi ~15–20 min.
  - 35 min · €0 per person

- **09:00** — [St Peter's Basilica](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=St+Peter%27s+Basilica+Rome)
  - Entry to the basilica is typically free; expect security queue and dress code. Dome climb or guided tours cost extra — check and pre-book if desired.
  - 120 min · €0 per person

- **12:30** — [Lunch](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Prati+neighbourhood+Rome)
  - Mid-range lunch ~€40 per person.
  - 60 min · €40 per person

- **14:30** — [Tiber riverside & Isola Tiberina walk](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Tiber+River+Rome)
  - Pleasant riverside nature walk; free.
  - 60 min · €0 per person

- **15:30** — [Walk back to Hotel 55 Fifty-Five](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome)
  - Return to the hotel to collect luggage; walking time depends on exact spot along the Tiber.
  - 20 min · €0 per person

- **15:50** — [Collect bags at hotel](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome)
  - Collect luggage and prepare for airport transfer. Moved earlier so you have time to reach Termini comfortably.
  - 20 min · €0 per person

- **16:10** — [Walk to Termini station](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome&destination=Termini+station+Rome)
  - Walk ~10–15 min to Termini. Alternative: short taxi ~€6–10 or bus (single ticket €1.50).
  - 15 min · €0 per person

- **16:40** — [Leonardo Express (Termini–FCO)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Leonardo+da+Vinci%E2%80%93Fiumicino+Airport+Rome)
  - Official train one-way €14 (2026). Departing Termini ~16:40 to arrive ~17:15 — gives ~4h before your 21:30 end time. Book tickets in advance; taxi to FCO (~€55) is an alternative.
  - 35 min · €14 per person

- **17:15** — [Arrive at airport — end of plan](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Leonardo+da+Vinci%E2%80%93Fiumicino+Airport+Rome)
  - Plan ends on arrival at FCO with a comfortable buffer before your 21:30 departure; nothing scheduled after this per request.
  - 15 min · €0 per person

response.itinerary_markdown:
# 3-day itinerary — Rome

## Day 1 — Arrival; Colosseum evening visit
- **15:30** — [Leonardo Express (FCO–Termini)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Termini+station+Rome)
  - Official train one-way €14 (2026). Trains ~32–35 min. Alternative: taxi flat €55 to historic centre.
  - 35 min · €14 per person

- **16:10** — [Walk to Hotel 55 Fifty-Five](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Termini+station+Rome&destination=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome)
  - High-walking pace; ~10–15 min on foot from Termini.
  - 15 min · €0 per person

- **16:30** — [Hotel check-in & luggage drop](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome)
  - Lodging costed once for the stay (estimate per person for 2 nights at a mid-range hotel).
  - 30 min · €160 per person

- **17:00** — [Walk to Colosseum](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome&destination=Colosseum+Rome)
  - Walk ~20–25 min at a brisk pace. Alternative: taxi ~10–15 min (€10–15).
  - 25 min · €0 per person

- **17:30** — [Colosseum](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Colosseum+Rome)
  - Timed-entry ticket Colosseum + Roman Forum + Palatine ~€18. Open until ~19:15 in early Sep; book a timed slot in advance.
  - 90 min · €18 per person

- **19:30** — [Dinner](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Monti+neighbourhood+Rome)
  - Mid-range dinner ~€80 per person.
  - 90 min · €80 per person


_Day total: €272_

## Day 2 — Historic centre, shopping at noon, Villa Borghese and Trastevere in evening
- **09:00** — [Trevi Fountain](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Trevi+Fountain+Rome)
  - Outdoor visit to the fountain and square — free.
  - 30 min · €0 per person

- **09:45** — [Pantheon](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Pantheon+Rome)
  - Visiting the square is free; interior may have a small entry fee (~€5). Priced as an approximate interior fee — check current policy.
  - 45 min · €5 per person

- **12:00** — Shopping stop
  - Shopping at noon as requested — browsing is free; purchases extra.
  - 90 min · €0 per person

- **13:30** — [Lunch](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Via+del+Corso+%2F+Centro+Rome)
  - Mid-range lunch ~€40 per person.
  - 60 min · €40 per person

- **15:00** — [Villa Borghese gardens (park walk)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Villa+Borghese+Rome)
  - Large park and gardens — nature-style time; free. Optional bike/boat rental extra.
  - 90 min · €0 per person

- **17:30** — [Public transport to Trastevere](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Trastevere+Rome)
  - Priced as a single public-transport ticket €1.50 per person. Alternative: scenic walk across the Tiber (~30–45 min) or taxi (~€10–15).
  - 25 min · €2 per person

- **19:30** — [Dinner](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Trastevere+Rome)
  - Mid-range dinner ~€80 per person; lively area for evening strolls.
  - 90 min · €80 per person


_Day total: €127_

## Day 3 — Vatican / St Peter's, riverside walk, return to airport
- **08:25** — [Walk to St Peter's Basilica](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome&destination=St+Peter%27s+Basilica+Rome)
  - Walk ~25–35 min to arrive by 09:00; leaves earlier than 09:00 so you can reach the basilica for opening. Alternative: bus/taxi ~15–20 min.
  - 35 min · €0 per person

- **09:00** — [St Peter's Basilica](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=St+Peter%27s+Basilica+Rome)
  - Entry to the basilica is typically free; expect security queue and dress code. Dome climb or guided tours cost extra — check and pre-book if desired.
  - 120 min · €0 per person

- **12:30** — [Lunch](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Prati+neighbourhood+Rome)
  - Mid-range lunch ~€40 per person.
  - 60 min · €40 per person

- **14:30** — [Tiber riverside & Isola Tiberina walk](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Tiber+River+Rome)
  - Pleasant riverside nature walk; free.
  - 60 min · €0 per person

- **15:30** — [Walk back to Hotel 55 Fifty-Five](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome)
  - Return to the hotel to collect luggage; walking time depends on exact spot along the Tiber.
  - 20 min · €0 per person

- **15:50** — [Collect bags at hotel](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome)
  - Collect luggage and prepare for airport transfer. Moved earlier so you have time to reach Termini comfortably.
  - 20 min · €0 per person

- **16:10** — [Walk to Termini station](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome&destination=Termini+station+Rome)
  - Walk ~10–15 min to Termini. Alternative: short taxi ~€6–10 or bus (single ticket €1.50).
  - 15 min · €0 per person

- **16:40** — [Leonardo Express (Termini–FCO)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Leonardo+da+Vinci%E2%80%93Fiumicino+Airport+Rome)
  - Official train one-way €14 (2026). Departing Termini ~16:40 to arrive ~17:15 — gives ~4h before your 21:30 end time. Book tickets in advance; taxi to FCO (~€55) is an alternative.
  - 35 min · €14 per person

- **17:15** — [Arrive at airport — end of plan](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Leonardo+da+Vinci%E2%80%93Fiumicino+Airport+Rome)
  - Plan ends on arrival at FCO with a comfortable buffer before your 21:30 departure; nothing scheduled after this per request.
  - 15 min · €0 per person


_Day total: €54_

**Total: €453 per person**
